purpose: Compare the existing documented Logopia workflow with the updated workflow for three matched, realistic brand-logo briefs. This is qualitative evidence from one sample per brief per workflow, not a general quality guarantee.

calls.failure_policy: Preserve an actual tool failure in the ledger; do not silently replace a failed or visually weak candidate. Tool infrastructure recovery needs an explicit amended protocol, not an unrecorded retry.
calls.image_conditioning: No reference images or prior generated candidates attached
calls.other_tool_parameters: Use only prompt for each new image; omit both referenced_image_paths and num_last_images_to_include. The exposed tool has no seed or model control.
calls.execution_batches: Baseline three independent calls may run in parallel; improved three may run in parallel after their prompts are fixed. Order within each parallel batch is not controlled.

palette_policy: Assistant-proposed advisory palettes with named roles. White canvas is authoritative for TIDE and 모아. No strict foreground exact-pixel export gate is invented. Folio's background is unspecified in both methods; record the chosen surface and actual result honestly.
comparison_criteria: Fit to the supplied product, audience, and desired personality
Observable distinguishing construction and avoidance of generic stock motifs
Exact text and Hangul identity where text is required; absence of text for TIDE
Contour, spacing, counters, symbol-to-lettering balance and clarity at declared sizes
Palette relationship, visible role separation and actual background treatment
Practical flat master-logo behavior versus unsolicited cinematic, emblematic or mockup treatment
limitations: One candidate per method per brief cannot establish a statistical improvement
Native model and sampling may vary; there is no exposed seed
Visual review and user preference remain distinct from measured file properties
The neutral comparison should preserve all six originals and exact prompts without making the better-looking candidate larger
generation_status_at_protocol_creation: No image calls have been made
